The next pass should check whether the head weakens the account/cacheSalt isolation, the default-on set, the 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, authentication before staging, the kill switch, or the demand gate for writes. The T-041 text still references the 30-minute TTL and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate. Any doc change that alters those claims needs a threat-model update.
